r.정치 구도: It fell into civil war soon after independence, and its peace deal is shaky.

t.why: Oil makes up most exports, and it relies on a pipeline through Sudan.
t.rel: It became independent from Sudan in 2011 but soon fell into civil war. It remains entangled with Sudan over the oil pipeline and the border area of Abyei.
t.korea: Korea's Hanbit unit is stationed there with UN peacekeepers.
t.know: Independent since 2011, South Sudan is the youngest member of the UN.
t.etext: Crude oil is almost all its exports and revenue. It can export only through a pipeline across Sudan, so it was hit directly by Sudan's civil war.
